cards.title: How to tell a rates sell-off from a fear sell-off: check what ISN'T falling
cards.why: Today gave a clean, fully sourced worked example — shares, gold and Bitcoin all down together while oil rose, then the whole thing reversed when one bond quote ticked up 0.07%. Teaches a repeatable test a family investor can run in four prices.

cards.title: 'The market' gave three different answers in the same minute
cards.why: London +0.09%, Frankfurt -0.24%, Nasdaq futures -0.88% at one timestamp, with oil up 1.38% as the whole explanation — a concrete way to show that index composition, not sentiment, drove the split.
